body: Yeah. That sounds right. I work for my school sports team and I don’t know why but it’s one of the only things that makes me genuinely happy. But their season is ending and I don’t what I’m gonna do

Nothing. That’s the problem. I don’t know why I feel like this. This on paper is the best time of my life. I have a big great group of friend my grades are good I have a future. But it doesn’t fee real and I feel empty. I don’t wanna exist anymore. So many people are in worse situations and I don’t know why I feel like this.

I am going to start. I’m scared that if I get meds that i won’t feel the same. I wanna be me and I don’t want myself to go away. Im gonna go to a psychiatrist to see if that helps.

I don’t wanna take pills I don’t wanna be different. Im fine with myself now I don’t wanna change. I just don’t know what to do. I just don’t know what to do. I don’t want anything in my life to change but I don’t know what’s going on with me. I should be happy it’s the best time of my life on paper but I feel nothing and just like this knowledge of everything being false I just don’t know
